# Every test target, test-only feature and pending #[ignore] of the kit (tools/check-targets.sh
# reads this file and checks it). One row per line: PACKAGE|KIND|NAME|FEATURES|PARTS, the
# format and the rules in tools/check-targets.sh's header. PARTS are tools/tests/full.sh's parts.
# A row whose PARTS holds "pending ruling" waits on a decision; none may be left when a change
# lands (CHECK_TARGETS_LANDING=1).
